name: Black Magic, White Cat
source:
A struggling student Necromancer suffers imposter syndrome when all he can summon is a white cat.

[Edited from [url=https://lyxil.itch.io/black-magic-white-cat]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名苦苦挣扎的见习死灵法师无论怎么施法都只能召唤出一只白猫，由此深深陷入了冒名顶替综合征的自我怀疑之中。

[摘自[url=https://lyxil.itch.io/black-magic-white-cat]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
